Re: Summit Roofing remittance
Hi,

Following up on our banking update. Our crew finished the roof last week, and we need today's payment to cover materials. Please make sure it goes to the account ending {last4}, not the old one ending {old_last4}, which is now closed.

The property manager's office already has the new details. There's no need to call our old number, since that line is being transferred. You can reach me at {phone} if needed.

Thanks for getting this into today's batch.

{signer}
{vendor}
